title: Domain and Value of a Hemispherical Function
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Find the natural domain of f(x, y) = sqrt(9 - x^2 - y^2) and evaluate f(1, 2).

steps.title: Determine Non-Negative Radicand Condition
steps.explanation: The square root is defined for real outputs if and only if its radicand is non-negative.

steps.title: Evaluate at Specified Point
steps.explanation: Substitute x = 1 and y = 2 into the function.
